text:
maria: Quick proposal — schedule unpin of SDK 2.7 from hosted runtime next Tue 10:00 PT. Goal: remove the soft-pin that blocks new runtime 3.14 kernels. canary -> 5% then 25% if healthy.

adam: +1. Which models are in scope for the canary? specifically Llama4-q and older Llama2-q variants.

maria: Canaries will include: llama4-q (quant-v4b), llama2-q-longseq (legacy quant). We'll exclude custom customer-spec models for the initial canary.

lina: Need fallback policy if llama4-q shows increased token latency. Suggest auto-fallback to llama4-q-compat (non-quant) and immediate throttle to dedicated pools.

paul: Add to release notes: SDK 2.7 unpin, runtime 3.14 compatibility changes, new kernel selector behavior, and the recommended quantization override flag.

maria: Deploy bot will run phased rollout. Here's the plan snippet:
```
/deploy scope=hosted runtime=3.14 sdk=2.7 canary=5% wait=15m monitor=latency,error-rate,cpu_util
if healthy -> rollout 25% after 1h
if regress -> rollback runtime to 3.13 and pin sdk back to 2.6
```

adam: What are the exact rollback commands and owners? we should pre-assign.

lina: Rollback runbook: ops@ oncall triggers /deploy rollback runtime=3.14 to=3.13, set sdk.pin=2.6, and run telemetry-checker job. Owners: ops@, runtime@, sdk@.

paul: Telemetry thresholds: p95 latency +15% or error-rate +0.5% absolute over baseline -> abort. Also watch kv-cache miss rate for quant models.

maria: Good call. I'll add the kv-cache metric to the runbook and tag runtime oncall. deploy-bot — schedule a dry-run tomorrow for the canary pipeline.

deploy-bot: scheduled: dry-run for sdk-unpin pipeline on 2026-04-06 16:00 PT. Notifying channels: eng-runtime, eng-releases.

adam: One more ask — include a short snippet in release notes about the new kernel-selection heuristic so SREs know why perf might shift.

maria: Will do. tagging runtime oncall and docs. :thumbsup:
